name: Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge
oracle_text:
Flying
When Jeleva enters, each player exiles the top X cards of their library, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast Jeleva.
Whenever Jeleva attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with Jeleva without paying its mana cost.

name: Kaho, Minamo Historian
oracle_text:
When Kaho enters, search your library for up to three instant cards, exile them, then shuffle.
{X}, {T}: You may cast a spell with mana value X from among cards exiled with Kaho without paying its mana cost.

name: Shell of the Last Kappa
oracle_text:
{3}, {T}: Exile target instant or sorcery spell that targets you. (The spell has no effect.)
{3}, {T}, Sacrifice Shell of the Last Kappa: You may cast a spell from among cards exiled with Shell of the Last Kappa without paying its mana cost.

name: Izzet Chemister
oracle_text:
Haste
{R}, {T}: Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.
{1}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Cast any number of cards exiled with this creature without paying their mana costs.

name: Rona, Disciple of Gix
oracle_text:
When Rona enters, you may exile target historic card from your graveyard. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
You may cast spells from among cards exiled with Rona.
{4}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library.

name: Pick Up the Pace
oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control that entered this turn attacks, exile the top card of your library.
You may play cards exiled with this enchantment as long as you attacked this turn.

name: Hedonist's Trove
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile target opponent's graveyard.
You may play lands from among cards exiled with this enchantment.
You may cast spells from among cards exiled with this enchantment. You can't cast more than one spell this way each turn.

name: Valgavoth, Terror Eater
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
Ward—Sacrifice three nonland permanents.
If a card you didn't control would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
During your turn, you may play cards exiled with Valgavoth. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.

name: Circu, Dimir Lobotomist
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a blue spell, exile the top card of target player's library.
Whenever you cast a black spell, exile the top card of target player's library.
Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as a card exiled with Circu.

name: Exclusion Ritual
oracle_text:
Imprint — When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent.
Players can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card.

name: Ixalan's Binding
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card.

name: Ashiok's Erasure
oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile target spell.
Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's hand.

name: Rest in Peace
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile all graveyards.
If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
